rev: Limited Liability Company Certificate of Organization (c156c512dllccert 10/6/11)
notes: Answers: managers (up to four), authorized signers (up to three) and real property signers (up to three) are one per line, 'name, business address': the name goes in the name box and the rest in the address box. The resident agent's name also goes in the consent line on page 2, which the agent signs (or the agent's consent is attached). 'None' leaves an optional line blank. The organizer's signatures on page 2 and the filing office's approval block are left blank.

The exact name of the limited liability company
lines.zh: 有限责任公司的确切名称

lines.en: Street address of the office in Massachusetts where its records will be kept
lines.zh: 在马萨诸塞州保存记录的办公室街道地址

lines.en: The general character of the business
Latest date of dissolution, if specified (or None)
lines.zh: 最迟解散日期（如有，或填 None）

lines.zh: 常驻代理人名称（个人或企业实体）

lines.zh: 常驻代理人在马萨诸塞州的街道地址

lines.zh: 经理，每行一位：“姓名、营业地址”（成员管理的填 None）
